description: Host profiles: what ./bootstrap apply --profiles selects. Each profile maps to manifest groups in manifest/packages.json; firewall maps to no group and runs the firewall stage. base_groups are installed on every run, headless included. The desktop set is the desktop layer (desktop apps, GNOME settings, snaps, VS Code); a selection with none of it is headless. catalogue names the host profile that owns a catalogue capability, so verify does not report gaps for a profile that was not selected.
